biotools.summary: FACT is a trainable clustering framework designed for spatial transcriptomics. It unifies multiple strategies (ACT, FACT, Scatter, Ensemble) and uses autoencoder-driven feature learning with Mclust-assisted clustering for joint optimization of representation and cluster assignment.
biotools.name: FACT: Trainable Clustering for Spatial Transcriptomics
